title: Exhaust Valve Control Solenoid Circuit High Bank 2
shortDescription: DTC P0085: exhaust valve control solenoid fault.
fullDescription: DTC P0085 indicates Exhaust Valve Control Solenoid Circuit High Bank 2. This range covers secondary fuel system, MAP/BARO and low-pressure fuel B sensors. Untreated, the engine may run lean, stall, or damage emissions hardware.
safetyImpact: Lean operation can overheat the catalytic converter. Stalling in traffic creates a safety risk.

causes.cause: Failed secondary fuel pump or driver module
Wiring harness chafing or corroded connector
Fuel pressure sensor out of spec
Clogged fuel filter or strainer
PCM/FPCM software calibration
Failed pump relay or fuse

symptoms: Stalling at idle or under load
Fuel pump runs continuously or not at all

fixSteps.title: Scan and Record Freeze Frame
fixSteps.instruction: Pull all DTCs and freeze-frame; note fuel pressure desired vs actual.

fixSteps.title: Measure Fuel Pressure
fixSteps.instruction: Connect a mechanical gauge to the test port; compare to spec at key-on and crank.

fixSteps.title: Test Pump Drive Circuit
fixSteps.instruction: Back-probe the pump driver, verify command duty cycle and supply voltage.

fixSteps.title: Replace Pump or Sensor
fixSteps.instruction: If the pump or pressure sensor is out of spec, replace and re-prime.

faq.q: Can I drive with this code?
faq.a: Short distances only. Low fuel pressure can lean out the engine and damage catalytic converters.
No. Sensor or pump faults are mechanical/electrical and need diagnosis.
Sensor swaps are DIY-friendly; in-tank pump work needs a lift and fire-safety setup.
